"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Progress as ProgressPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/progress"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import type { WithClassName } from "./_shared"

const Progress = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  WithClassName<ProgressPrimitive.Root.Props>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ProgressPrimitive.Root ref={ref} className={cn("w-full", className)} {...props}>
    <ProgressPrimitive.Track className="relative h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-secondary [box-shadow:var(--shadow-track-inset)]">
      <ProgressPrimitive.Indicator className="h-full [background-image:var(--fill-primary)] transition-all duration-slow ease-out" />
    </ProgressPrimitive.Track>
  </ProgressPrimitive.Root>
))
Progress.displayName = "Progress"

export { Progress }
